items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: My drummers were — the most primitive one was my drum teacher in 1949 or ’50 I guess, Tony Spargo.

ctx.x: Really. Find a different bunch of guys?
Yeah. My drummers were — the most primitive one was my drum teacher in 1949 or ’50 I guess, Tony Spargo. He was the drummer with the Original Dixieland Jazz Band.
You took lessons from Tony Spargo?
